predictions.shared_matters: Removing the shared expert costs: S0_K16 is at least 15% worse than S768_K16, and S0_K32 at least 15% worse than S768_K32 (the user's hunch is that it costs little).
predictions.finer_helps: More, smaller experts help at the same budget: S768_K16 and S768_K32 are both below the baseline, S768_K32 the lowest of the shared-768 pair.
predictions.smaller_shared: A 10% shared expert is within 10% of the 25% one at the same K.
predictions.S24_K18: Dropping the shared expert at today's expert size is worse than the baseline by at least 15%.

criteria: Paired document bootstrap within domains (as moe_carve.py), config minus baseline: upper 95% bound below 0 means better than today's carve, lower bound above 0 means worse, otherwise a tie. The shared-expert predictions are read from the same-K pairs. A config goes to the learned-router stage only if it beats the baseline by this rule.
